value.rationale: The primary 2026 Hardy distribution transport explicitly isolates measures with atoms as a separate mathematical case, and the 2018 general-measure inequality leaves the exact sharp norm unknown. This natural single-atom model is solved completely: a phase-quantized compact singular spectrum, simplicity, exact trace mass, Schatten frontier, uniform spectral rank structure, and two mutually different atom limits, including a sharp logarithmic-square edge. Exact full-spectrum structural information has intrinsic relevance to spectral approximation and sharp Hardy constants, beyond textbook norm estimates.
